target_properties.target_description: Welcome to the Moon!;Discussion theme: Warm up to science observations of the Moon.
target_properties.unaided_eye_actions: Topics to discuss with available crew:;1. Help orient each other using major landmarks.;2. What about your view is familiar (features, color, etc.)?;3. What about your view is unexpected?;Annotate your observations along with your discussion.
target_properties.camera_actions: Topics to discuss with available crew:;1. Help orient each other using major landmarks.;2. What about your view is familiar (features, color, etc.)?;3. What about your view is unexpected?;Capture images along with your discussion.
target_properties.impact_statement: The observations you will make throughout the flyby will pave the way for the next generation of lunar exploration.

target_properties.target_description: Discussion theme: Regional-scale albedo/color variations across the farside.

What patterns/variations in regional color or hue do you see? Are they associated with specific features?;Annotate your observations along with your discussion.

target_properties.impact_statement: The transition between the nearside and farside reveals how differences in thermal/magmatic histories shaped crustal evolution.

target_properties.target_description: High albedo, complex crater with prominent ray system.;W of Oceanus Procellarum, SE of Ohm, NE of Orientale.;First of two craters in Crater Duo (Glushko, Ohm).;First of two photometric observations of Glushko for this crew.
target_properties.unaided_eye_actions: Describe the extent of Glushko's ejecta/ray system.;Describe brightness, color, and texture variations along or between Glushko's rays.;Describe how Glushko's rays differ in the mare vs. highlands.;Compare the ejecta/ray systems of Glushko to Ohm.
target_properties.camera_actions: Centered images of entire crater and ray system in a single frame.;Image and compare the brightness and extent of rays in Ohm's and Glushko's ray systems.;Image and describe how Glushko's rays differ in the mare vs. highlands.;Image and describe color, albedo, and texture variations along or between Glushko's rays.
target_properties.impact_statement: Your observations will be used to understand material properties of a young lunar crater.; Repeat observations will inform how changes in viewing conditions affect human perception of brightness, color, and texture.

target_properties.target_description: Small, complex crater with prominent ray system.;Size of the "Eye of the Sahara" in Mauritania.;Second of two craters in Crater Duo (Glushko, Ohm).
target_properties.unaided_eye_actions: Describe the extent of Ohm's ejecta/ray system.;Describe albedo, color, and texture variations along or between Ohm's rays.;Compare the ejecta/ray systems of Ohm to Glushko.
target_properties.camera_actions: Centered images of entire crater and ray system in a single frame.;Image and compare the brightness and extent of rays in Ohm's and Gluskho's ray systems.;Image and describe color, albedo, and texture variations along or between Ohm's rays.
target_properties.impact_statement: Observations will be used to understand the formation, dynamics, and weathering of extensive crater ray systems.

target_properties.target_description: Plateau known for its volcanic diversity and the bright Aristarchus crater.;Within NW Oceanus Procellarum near limb.
target_properties.unaided_eye_actions: Describe any color/albedo variations across the plateau.; Describe any resolvable features on the plateau, such as topographic highs or lava channels.; How does the color/albedo of Aristarchus crater and rays compare to other bright features on the Moon?
target_properties.camera_actions: Centered image of plateau in full zoom.; Image and describe any topographic highs or lava chanels across the plateau.; Image and describe any color/albedo variations across the plateau.; Image and describe the colors and textures of Aristarchus crater and rays.
target_properties.impact_statement: Your observations will inform the complex and varied volcanic and tectonic history of this unique lunar feature.

target_properties.target_description: Set of bright lunar swirls.;In W Oceanus Procellarum near highland-mare boundary.
target_properties.unaided_eye_actions: Can you see the swirls with the unaided eye? If so, what shapes and patterns can you resolve?;Describe any color/albedo variations of Reiner Gamma.
target_properties.camera_actions: Centered image of swirls at full zoom.;Image and describe the color/albedo and patterns within the swirls. Are there any variations among the different swirls?; Image and describe the shapes of the swirls.
target_properties.impact_statement: Your observations of the swirls provide clues as to how magnetism preserves lunar regolith against space weathering.

target_properties.target_description: Handover and switch with your crewmates.
Not made of cheese.
target_properties.unaided_eye_actions: Orient yourself to the Moon.;Describe color, albedo, texture, and topography variations visible across the surface.; Describe topography and color variations within the iluminated part of SPA Basin.
target_properties.camera_actions: Orient yourself to the Moon.;Whole Moon mosaic: N-S snake pattern at mid-zoom w/ overlap.;Image and describe color/albedo variations across the surface.
target_properties.impact_statement: No one else has seen the Moon from this angle in the history of the Solar System!;Your observations of SPA basin and whole Moon characteristics will help to unravel the history of the Moon in time and space.

target_properties.target_description: Youngest large basin on the Moon.;Prominent ejecta with secondary crater chains.; Diameter is distance between JSC and KSC
target_properties.unaided_eye_actions: Describe color, albedo, texture, and topography across mare patches and ring mountains.; Describe southern dark annular ring, including boundaries and texture.;Describe any color/albedo variations of ejecta.
target_properties.camera_actions: Centered images of entire basin and surrounding craters in a single frame.;Mosaic entire basin at full zoom w/ overlap.;Image and describe color, albedo, texture, and topography across mare patches and ring mountains.;Image and describe southern dark annular ring, including boundaries and texture.;Image and describe color/albedo variations of ejecta.
target_properties.impact_statement: Observations will be used to study the geologic evolution of the youngest lunar basin and to inform formation hypotheses for the annular ring.

target_properties.target_description: Degraded basin with inner and outer rings.;SW of Ohm, NW of Orientale.
target_properties.unaided_eye_actions: Describe and compare the degradation of the rings.; Describe and compare color and texture inside and outside of the inner ring.;Compare this degraded basin (basin floor, rings, and ejecta) with the younger Orientale Basin.

target_properties.target_description: Short-lived flashes on the lunar surface caused by impact bombardment.
target_properties.unaided_eye_actions: Monitor dark regions of the Moon for impact flashes.;If observed, report number, annotate location, and describe flash (color, brightness, shape, duration).
target_properties.camera_actions: No images required, but can use the camera as a viewfinder.;Monitor dark regions of the Moon for impact flashes.;If observed, report number, annotate location, and describe flash (color, brightness, shape, duration).
target_properties.impact_statement: Observations of impact flashes will be used to provide insight into the Moon's dynamic environment as well as the impactors that modify the lunar surface and build the regolith and dust environment.

target_properties.target_description: Lunar dust may be lofted above the lunar surface.;Observe just before the Earth rises.; Earthshine will illuminate any lofted dust (but the brightness of Earth will wash out any faint dust after Earthrise).
target_properties.unaided_eye_actions: Is there any evidence of glow from lofted lunar dust along the horizon?;Comment on the sharpness or fuzziness of the lunar limb.
target_properties.camera_actions: Capture images of the dark limb at multiple scales to potentially identify dust in the exosphere.;Is there any evidence of glow along the horizon?;N-S snaking mosaic limb at full zoom w/ overlap.;Ensure focal point remains on an illuminated surface.;Image and describe any colors visible along the Moonâ€™s limb.
target_properties.impact_statement: Your observations will be used to understand the dust environment within the exosphere in the context of observations from Apollo missions and orbital spacecraft.

target_properties.target_description: Handover and switch with your crewmates.

Solar corona: The outer atmosphere of the Sun.;Polar plume: Thin streamers that project from the Sun's N and S poles.; Helmet streamer: Long cap-like structure with pointed peaks.; Coronal loop: Arcs close to Sun's surface.; Lunar dust: Dust from the Moon that is lofted above the lunar surface and illuminated by the Sun.
target_properties.unaided_eye_actions: Describe the visibility, color, and shape of the solar corona as a whole and its substructures (e.g., plumes, streamers).;Describe the glow behind the horizon, if glow is visible.;Describe the morphology of the lunar limb, including its sharpness or fuzziness.
target_properties.camera_actions: Use D5 with long lens.;Image and describe the visibility, color, and shape of the solar corona as a whole and its substructures (e.g., plumes, streamers).;Is there any evidence of glow behind the horizon? If so, image and describe at multiple scales.;Image and describe the morphology of the lunar limb, including its sharpness or fuzziness.
target_properties.impact_statement: Your observations and continuous image captures will be used to understand dynamics of the solar corona.;The eclipse provides a unique viewing geometry to search for possible lofted dust above the lunar surface.
